INSTRUCTIONS_A: In this task, words will appear in the center of the screen, one at a time. Each word is the name of a color (rosa, azul, verde or preto) and is written in a color that never matches the word (for example, the word "verde" written in blue). The task has two parts. In the first part, the reading block, you will indicate the word that is written. In the second part, the naming block, you will indicate the color the word is written in. There is a practice before you start. You will respond with the keys D, F, J and K. Keep the index and middle fingers of both hands on these keys. Each key corresponds to a color: This mapping will always be shown at the bottom of the screen. Press any key to continue.
INSTRUCTIONS_B: In this task, words will appear in the center of the screen, written in different colors. Your task is to indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. Sometimes the word and the color do not match (for example, the word "verde" written in blue); other times only "XXXXX" appears. Always respond to the ink color, not to the word. You will respond with the keys D, F, J and K. Keep the index and middle fingers of both hands on these keys. Each key corresponds to a color: This mapping will always be shown at the bottom of the screen. Press any key to continue.
READINGINTRO: READING BLOCK In this block, indicate the word that is written, ignoring the color it is written in. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for verde. Press any key to continue.
NAMINGINTRO: NAMING BLOCK Now the rule changes. In this block, indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for azul. Press any key to continue.
PRACTICE_A_NEUTRAL: PRACTICE First, "XXXXX" will appear written in different colors. Press the key for the color it is written in. Press any key to continue.
PRACTICE_A_READING: PRACTICE: READING Now color names will appear. Indicate the word that is written, ignoring the color it is written in. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for verde. Press any key to continue.
PRACTICE_A_NAMING: PRACTICE: NAMING Now the rule changes: indicate the color each word is written in, ignoring what the word says. For example, if the word "verde" appears written in blue, press the key for azul. Press any key to continue.
KEYPRACTICE: Before the practice, learn which color goes with each key. Press D, F, J and K to see the color of each one, as often as you like. When you are ready, press the space bar to start the practice. In the practice, after each response you will be told whether it was correct.
KEYREMINDER: You can review the color of each key by pressing D, F, J and K. When you are ready, press the space bar to start.
FOOTER2_LEITURA: Respond to the written word as quickly and accurately as possible.
FOOTER2_NOMEACAO: Respond to the ink color as quickly and accurately as possible.
